split_unit: connected regulatory document family including all amendments, versions and obligation paraphrases
assignment: Sort canonical family IDs not used in development by SHA256(protocol_id + family_id); assign the first ceil(0.3*N) whole families to heldout, the remainder to development; preserve assignments in a versioned split manifest before tuning.
after_holdout_inspection: If results guide tuning, retire those cases to development and collect a fresh independent final holdout.
claims_limit: No measured reliability claim before independently reviewed labels and held-out evaluation exist.
